name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 3 - Am 30
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 3a. Stresses that democracy requires political contestation and the possibility of peaceful change of power; recalls that opposition, dissent and public criticism are normal features of democratic life and must be embraced rather than treated as threats merely because they challenge institutions or governing majorities; underlines that a democracy shield must protect citizens from hostile actors, not institutions from citizens;
